rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the flow of blood through the body, especially in medical or health contexts.

example.english: The doctor said my bloodstream isn't very good, so I need to exercise more.
example.traditional: 醫生話我血液循環唔係幾好，要多啲做運動。
